messages.subject: R/qtl2 version 0.24
messages.body_plain:
Just posted a new version of R/qtl2 to CRAN.
The windows and Mac binaries should show up in a few days.
Use update.packages() to update your R packages, or install.packages("qtl2") to re-install R/qtl.

The biggest changes are below. There were also a number of bug fixes. For the full list of changes see https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/blob/master/NEWS.md

karl

---

Major changes
Revised treatment of X chromosome in "general AIL" cross type, to be the same as the autosomes but with 2/3 as many generations for recombination. This should provide a better approximation.
Minor changes

Revised reduce_markers() so that it can handle the case of many markers, by working with them in smaller batches.

fit1() now returns both fitted values and residuals.

fit1() can be run with genotype probabilities omitted, in which case an intercept column of 1's is used (Issue #151 <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/issues/151>).

Updated mouse gene database with 2020-09-07 data from MGI <http://www.informatics.jax.org/downloads/mgigff3/archive/monthly/>.

Implemented Issue #184 <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/issues/184>, to make calc_het() multi-core.

Made the vdiffr <https://vdiffr.r-lib.org> package optional: only test the plots locally, and only if vdiffr is installed.

calc_sdp() can now take a plain vector (Issue #142 <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/issues/142>).

Added a lodcolumn argument to maxlod() (Issue #137 <https://github.com/rqtl/qtl2/issues/137>).
